en.summary: Multi-tenant SaaS for managing the quality lifecycle: test cases, plans, manual runs, bugs with evidence, and Playwright report import.
did: Built the product and the suite that tests it: unit, integration, security, E2E and accessibility running in CI.
Playwright JSON report import with a project token, straight from the pipeline.
Optional AI assistant per organization, with secrets redacted and output validated.
en.imageAlt: QA-Testing-Manager dashboard showing project, test case and bug counts, pass rate and execution history, using demo data.
